acceptanceCriteria: A table value reached through global or shared runtime state (globalThis/window/self properties, Symbol.for keys, classic-script top-level var, prototype writes) written by a module outside the examined chain cannot produce a resolved StateConstants value: the result is UNKNOWN / not-read-whole, or the writer is found.
A failing-before fixture (off-chain module assigns globalThis.ST = SectionTable; relay exports ST; registering file writes through the relay) proves the gap.
body: Follow-up from V1-1061 (GitHub #705) review round 13 adversarial pass, recorded as a Limit in docs/build-log/2026-10-09-v1-1061-appmap-enum-barrel.md. Confirmed by scratch test: an off-chain module does (globalThis as any).ST = SectionTable, a relay has export default ST, and the registering file writes through import R from relay; SectionNames.REPORTS still resolves to 'ledger'. Covering it needs free-identifier (scope) analysis or a repository-wide scan for global writes. Related limit: run-time computed member keys (globalThis['ev'+'al'], obj[k] reaching constructor).
title: appmap: StateConstants table reached through global/shared runtime state written off-chain still resolves
